name: viewsmax
description: Post once, publish everywhere: draft, schedule and publish to YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Instagram and Bluesky from a conversation. Find outlier videos that massively beat their channel's average and remake them for your niche, plan the week, and track offer clicks and revenue through the ViewsMax MCP server.

interface.longDescription: ViewsMax lets you post once and publish everywhere from your AI agent or app, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok or Muse. Give it one idea and it drafts the post for every connected account, schedules or publishes it, and reviews what's coming up. You can list connected accounts and brands, check platform requirements, upload media, create drafts or scheduled posts, and update post settings. Before posting, find outlier videos that massively beat their channel's average and remake them for your niche; that works with just a ViewsMax login.
capabilities: Publish one post to several platforms at once
Schedule social posts for a set date and time
Plan and manage a content calendar
Find outlier videos for any topic or creator and remake them for your niche
Track offer links, clicks and revenue
defaultPrompt: Post this to all my accounts: <your caption>
Find outlier videos about <your niche> and draft my version for X and LinkedIn
Plan and schedule this week's posts across my accounts
